purpose: Diagnose the contribution of the existing CMSA-inspired pooled-grid anchor score to automatic Lean, keeping the initial prompt and full-video schedule identical.
selection: The videos were selected after inspecting their outcomes, with seq2 as a relatively strong reference. This is a targeted exploratory diagnosis, not an independent cohort or population estimate.
control: Replay the saved first YOLO box and existing early-feature points under the same Lean model, box-mask conversion, FP32 precision, memory budget and full chronological video. Set the pooled-anchor strength to zero so the original released Lean anchor score is used. All other conditions remain fixed. The already-saved automatic combined run is the comparison; native and unmodified GT-prompt Lean are not rerun.
inference: No re-detection, new confidence gating or new decision thresholds. Before the first original detection output empty. Source boxes and points were generated automatically; GT is never used in inference. Read labels only after all masks of a sequence are saved.
verification: Two independent full seq3 replay checks must exactly reproduce every saved original combined mask and token-selection records under strength 0.5. Confirm same checkpoints, predictor source, original prompt and all frame identities, source hash and weight integrity. Require those receipts before ablation. Independently rescore all saved masks and match historical frame IDs.
metrics: Equal-sequence present Dice on all frames and existing historical target IDs; per-sequence means, matched-frame changes, empty-frame false alarms and actual token counts. Report uncertainty as descriptive only for these selected sequences.
limitations: Changing memory scoring changes later predictions and memory; results measure the full trajectory, not isolated instantaneous token utility. Automatic and historical GT-prompt runs remain unmatched in initialization. The detector checkpoint split is unknown and all video data are previously inspected.
